name: carousel
summary: Slides on a scroll-snap track, and which one is showing.

track.doc: The scroll-snap container the browser moves.

slide.doc: One per slide, inside the track.

active.doc: The index of the slide showing.

go.doc: Scrolls to a slide, wrapping round.

next.doc: Scrolls to the next slide; the last goes back to the first.

previous.doc: Scrolls to the previous slide; the first goes to the last.
